parts:
Sorry, I meant the my original post about the warning message. 
When I disable the Trend Micro Anti-Virus program. 
There is no warning while compiling stan model. 

I think it has something to do with another warning I get for any command in Windows Command Prompt, when Trend-Micro is enabled. 

C:\Users\sreen>ipconfig
[0x7FF8667F70E3] ANOMALY: use of REX.w is meaningless (default operand size is 64)


Apparently there is some issue with this software in Windows 10 new update, unfortunately cant change it because of University policy. 

Anyhow, I manage to run my models now without compilation error or warning, when TrendMicro is disabled. 

Thank you again. 
Best
Sreenath Madathil
